related.title: OCP 冷卻液：露點餘裕與凝結風險邊界
related.titleEn: OCP coolant loops: dew-point margin and condensation boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付能量帳本、溫升序列、25 秒反應判定與局部熱點模型限制；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the energy ledger, temperature sequence, 25-second response assessment and local-hotspot limitation. The exercise changes synthetic thermal inputs only and performs no physical cooling intervention. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 記錄 location、surface_temperature、dew_point、uncertainty 與時間戳；同一位置和時刻的量測才可直接比較。
related.differenceEn: Record location, surface temperature, dew point, uncertainty and timestamps. Compare observations from compatible locations and times, retaining any assumption used to approximate an unmeasured surface.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 固定淨熱功率下 C*dT/dt=P，達容許溫升 ΔT 的時間為 CΔT/P；C 需為熱容量，不是比熱；有效熱容量 500 kJ/K，容許升溫 8 K；淨熱量由 100 增為 200 kW，冷卻移除已從 P 扣除；名義式 500*8/100 = 40 s to modeled limit；變更式 500*8/200 = 20 s to modeled limit。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
教學凝結餘裕為 Tsurface-Tdew；負值表示模型條件下有凝結風險，正值仍需考慮感測誤差與局部差異；暴露表面 18°C；局部露點由 16°C 升至 19°C，表面溫度固定；數值差使用 K；名義式 18-16 = 2 K margin；變更式 18-19 = -1 K margin。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Under constant net heat input, C*dT/dt=P, so time to allowed rise ΔT is CΔT/P. C is total thermal capacitance, not specific heat, and the model assumes a uniformly represented temperature. Set effective capacitance to 500 kJ/K and allowable temperature rise to 8 K. Net heat input changes from 100 to 200 kW, with any remaining heat removal already subtracted from P. Nominal 500*8/100 = 40 s to modeled limit; changed 500*8/200 = 20 s to modeled limit. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

Condensation margin is surface temperature minus dew point. A negative value signals risk under the modeled conditions; a positive value still requires allowance for measurement error and spatial variation. Keep an exposed surface at 18°C while local dew point rises from 16°C to 19°C. Temperature differences are reported in K, and the dew points are given fixture inputs rather than calculated humidity measurements. Nominal 18-16 = 2 K margin; changed 18-19 = -1 K margin. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: CP2K：SCF 收縮、停止原因與假收斂診斷
related.titleEn: CP2K: SCF contraction, stopping reasons and false-convergence diagnosis
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付能量帳本、溫升序列、25 秒反應判定與局部熱點模型限制；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the energy ledger, temperature sequence, 25-second response assessment and local-hotspot limitation. The exercise changes synthetic thermal inputs only and performs no physical cooling intervention. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「CP2K：SCF 收縮、停止原因與假收斂診斷」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付殘差歷程、停止原因表、能量與缺陷對照以及續算決策紀錄。
related.differenceEn: Investigate CP2K: SCF contraction, stopping reasons and false-convergence diagnosis using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver residual histories, stopping-reason tables, energy-versus-defect comparisons and a restart decision explaining which downstream quantities remain unqualified when electronic convergence fails.

逐項乘 0.2，計算 e6 並與 1e−5 比較；以相鄰缺陷之比重新估計 q，交由另一人核算。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。

C is total thermal capacitance, not specific heat, and the model assumes a uniformly represented temperature. Set effective capacitance to 500 kJ/K and allowable temperature rise to 8 K. Multiply successively by 0.2, calculate the sixth defect and compare it with 1e-5. Independently estimate q from adjacent history entries and ask a second investigator to check the iteration numbering and threshold comparison.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
